notes:
I don't have any notes for you yet. Nothing I fetched made it into a form I could read, so I can't give you verse-by-verse notes on Ezekiel 10.

I requested six pages in one batch:
- https://enduringword.com/bible-commentary/ezekiel-10/
- https://biblehub.com/commentaries/ellicott/ezekiel/10.htm
- https://biblehub.com/commentaries/gill/ezekiel/10.htm
- https://biblehub.com/commentaries/pulpit/ezekiel/10.htm
- https://www.preceptaustin.org/ezekiel-10-commentary
- https://netbible.org/bible/Ezekiel+10

The tool did send back responses, but my code to read them crashed. When I tried to fix it, I'd hit the limit on tool calls for this turn, so I never saw a word of any of those pages. I don't know if any of the fetches actually worked.

Your rules say to report only what the pages actually say and never to fill gaps from my own knowledge, so I haven't written anything. That covers the traditional reading, the differences between Protestant traditions and the other views.

**Next steps:** If you send the request again or say "continue," I'll start with those six pages. Then I'll look for:
- **Protestant traditions:** Reformed (Ligonier, Monergism, TGC), Baptist (Spurgeon, Desiring God, GTY), Wesleyan (wesley.nnu.edu), Pentecostal (samstorms.org, pneumareview.com) and Lutheran (lcms.org, 1517.org) material on Ezekiel 10.
- **Catholic and Orthodox:** newadvent.org, catholic.com and oca.org, which may cover the Church Fathers on the cherubim and the glory leaving the temple.
- **Older commentators:** others on studylight.org and ccel.org.

Then I'll write the notes verse by verse, with a URL after each point, and leave out any verse or view I can't find a source for.
